Handcrafted Itineraries

Curated Wildlife Expeditions

Privately guided journeys led by career Ugandan naturalists. Every itinerary can be tailored to your exact dates, photographic focus, and luxury accommodation preferences.

Primate & Gorilla
10 Days / 9 Nights

Private Tailored

The Great Albertine Rift & Gorilla Habituation Expedition

This signature overland safari is engineered for discerning travelers who want more than a brief wildlife glimpse. By securing the rare Uganda Wildlife Authority Mountain Gorilla Habituation permit, you spend four full immersive hours with a semi-habituated wild gorilla family in Bwindi southern sector, accompanying research biologists and trackers. The journey also explores the ancient Kibale canopy for chimpanzee tracking, traverses the Queen Elizabeth savanna, and cruises the wildlife-rich Kazinga Channel.

Entebbe Kibale Forest Queen Elizabeth Ishasha Sector +2 more
Official 4-hour Mountain Gorilla Habituation Experience in Bwindi Impenetrable Forest
Full tracking expedition in Kibale National Park with 13 primate species
Private Rate From $6,850 / person

Classic Savanna
8 Days / 7 Nights

Private Tailored

The Classic Uganda Big Game & Gorilla Circuit

Designed for travelers seeking the ultimate balance between classic African savanna game drives and mountain gorilla tracking. This 8-day private journey covers the misty rainforests of Bwindi, the diverse habitats of Queen Elizabeth National Park, and the serene acacia woodlands of Lake Mburo.

Entebbe Lake Mburo Queen Elizabeth Ishasha +1 more
Guaranteed Bwindi Mountain Gorilla Tracking permit with experienced trackers
Morning and dusk predator safaris across Kasenyi and Ishasha savanna
Private Rate From $4,950 / person

Grand Expedition
8 Days / 7 Nights

Private Tailored

Kidepo Valley & Murchison Falls Frontier Expedition

For the adventurous safari enthusiast who wants uncrowded expanses, dramatic raw landscapes, and wilderness exclusivity. This expedition combines the thunderous power of Murchison Falls National Park with the breathtaking isolation of Kidepo Valley National Park near the northern borders.

Entebbe Murchison Falls Lake Albert Delta Kidepo Valley +1 more
Fly-in bush flight into remote Kidepo Valley surrounded by the Morungole Mountains
Private game drives across Narus Valley tracking cheetahs, lions, and vast buffalo herds
Private Rate From $5,400 / person

Primate & Gorilla
7 Days / 6 Nights

Private Tailored

Primates of the Pearl: Chimpanzees, Gorillas & Golden Monkeys

Uganda is universally recognized as Africa's greatest primate sanctuary. This focused 7-day itinerary tracks three of the continent's most iconic primate species: habituated eastern chimpanzees in Kibale, mountain gorillas in Bwindi, and endangered golden monkeys on the bamboo slopes of Mount Gahinga.

Entebbe Kibale Forest Bwindi Impenetrable Mgahinga Gorilla Park +1 more
Kibale National Park chimpanzee tracking with senior primatologist
Mountain Gorilla tracking permit in the mist-veiled forests of Bwindi
Private Rate From $4,600 / person

Classic Savanna
6 Days / 5 Nights

Private Tailored

Rwenzori Glacial Foothills & Savanna Wilderness Expedition

Ptolemy's legendary 'Mountains of the Moon' rise dramatically above the western Albertine Rift. This expedition combines guided treks through the giant heather and moss-draped valleys of the Rwenzori foothills with big game safaris across Queen Elizabeth National Park.

Entebbe Fort Portal Rwenzori Foothills Queen Elizabeth +1 more
Guided day trek into Rwenzori Mountains National Park along the pristine Mubuku Valley
Boat cruise along the Kazinga Channel with thousands of hippos and river birds
Private Rate From $3,800 / person

Photographic & Birding
12 Days / 11 Nights

Small Guild Group (Max 6)

Uganda Birding & Albertine Rift Endemics Quest

Led by Uganda's most celebrated senior ornithologist guides, this comprehensive birding safari visits Mabamba Bay papyrus swamp, the Albertine Rift montane forests of Bwindi (voted Africa's number one birding destination), Kibale Forest, and Queen Elizabeth National Park.

Mabamba Bay Kibale Forest Queen Elizabeth Bwindi Ruhija +1 more
Mabamba Bay wetland traditional canoe excursion to locate the elusive Shoebill Stork
Ruhija Mubwindi Swamp trek searching for the rare African Green Broadbill
Private Rate From $7,200 / person
